name: Agency
description: A premium editorial agency website template for DevSnips built with semantic HTML, CSS (Pico CSS foundation), and vanilla JavaScript. A dark-first, high-contrast editorial layout combining bold typography, an asymmetric hero, an about + statistics section, an editorial services list, selected work with alternating project layouts, a featured case study, a five-step process, a capabilities grid, a team grid, testimonials, an insights/blog section, and a contact CTA, plus a sticky header with responsive mobile navigation, scroll-reveal animations, and scrollspy active navigation. Split into modular files: code.html + style.css + script.js, with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. Follows the shared design-tokens.md system.
features: sticky header with responsive mobile navigation (aria-expanded toggle)
large-typography hero with asymmetric text + image grid
selected work with alternating image/content project layouts
featured case study (challenge, approach, solution, results)
insights/blog section with meta (category, date, read time)
scrollspy active navigation state with aria-current
darkMode: dark-first (fixed dark theme; no light-mode toggle)
browserSupport: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (modern evergreen browsers)
accessibility: semantic HTML landmarks (header, nav, main, section, article, footer)
accessible mobile navigation with aria-expanded state and aria-controls
aria-current on the active scrollspy navigation link
reduced-motion support (prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scroll, reveal, and transitions)
